sources.title: Composed image retrieval: a survey on recent research and development
sources.snippet: In recent years, composed image retrieval (CIR) has gained significant attention within the research community due to its excellent research value and extensive real-world applications. CIR allows modifying query images based on user-provided text descriptions, producing search results that better match users' intent. This paper conducts a comprehensive and up-to-date survey of CIR research ...
